cohort: Consecutive patients who underwent ileocolic resection by laparoscopy for Crohn's disease at a single tertiary colorectal surgery referral center between 2012 and 2020.
finding: Single-port laparoscopy for ileocolic resection in Crohn's disease yielded better cosmetic outcomes (body image and cosmesis) than multiport laparoscopy, with similar postoperative complication and long-term incisional hernia rates.
